summary: GreenPower Motor Company filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching a press release outlining plans to build an initial 50 all-electric EV Star Cab Chassis shuttle buses with a new strategic partner reportedly having secured over $2.5 billion for electric mobility projects. Body assembly is slated for Mexico, using the planned New Mexico facility for staging. The company retained Mexico-based Victor Pliego to oversee cab chassis importation and body builds. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
